prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a seamless tileable grayscale textile pattern mask for a cozy 3D life simulation game, not a cloth photograph. Primary request: one square flat repeat print of scattered tiny hand-painted daisies and paired soft leaves on a pure black background. Flowers are softly hand-painted ivory/white petals in GRAYSCALE ONLY, centers medium gray, little leaves dark gray; delicately varied petal shapes and occasional small buds. Charming restrained cottage textile, clean enough to remain readable on small clothes, lampshades and a bed quilt. Composition: evenly spaced small motifs across the entire square, a natural loose tossed repeat, approximately 20 small daisy sprigs in the full tile; several motifs wrap correctly across opposite tile edges, no central bouquet, no central focal point, no empty border. Technical constraints: exact seamless left/right and top/bottom repetition; flat orthographic 2D print, every pixel opaque, background black #000000, motifs use only grayscale black to white, no hue. The image is a pattern mask whose black areas will become the user's cloth base color and white areas their cream accent; retain soft hand-painted detail within the motifs. Avoid fabric folds, weave photography, shadows, lighting gradients, vignettes, perspective, borders, letters, watermark, UI, color. Generate a single square texture asset.
edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached grayscale daisy textile mask. Preserve the existing soft hand-painted daisy and leaf style, grayscale only on pure opaque black. Correct the tile edges for use as a repeating fabric pattern: REMOVE every partial flower, bud or leaf that is cut by any of the four image edges. The outermost 35 pixels along all four sides must be perfectly solid black #000000, with no visible motif, no gray noise, and no frame line. Retain all complete interior daisy sprigs and keep their sizes and loose tossed spacing. Do not add a border graphic or vignette: just clean black negative space at the perimeter so adjoining tiles meet in the black background. One square grayscale pattern mask, no fabric photograph, folds, lighting, labels or color.
channels: Grayscale pattern mask; base dye plus cream accent. Not independent flower/leaf color regions.
